# Options reference

craggy-charts options. One flat object; every key is optional except type and data (or value for single-value types). Identical in every language.

| Option | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `'line' \| 'area' \| 'bar' \| 'histogram' \| 'scatter' \| 'bubble' \| 'range' \| 'candlestick' \| 'ohlc' \| 'boxplot' \| 'waterfall' \| 'heatmap' \| 'calendar' \| 'pie' \| 'donut' \| 'gauge' \| 'radialBar' \| 'radar' \| 'rose' \| 'waffle' \| 'treemap' \| 'funnel' \| 'progress' \| 'stat'` | Chart type. |
| `data` | `Data` | Rows ([{...}]), plain numbers ([3, 5, 2]) or columns ({ a: [...], b: [...] }). |
| `x` | `Channel` | x / category / label column. Default: first text or date column, else the row index. |
| `y` | `Channel \| Channel[]` | One value column or a list of them; each is a series. Default: every number column. |
| `by` | `string` | Split long (tidy) data into series by this column. |
| `value` | `number \| string` | Value column (heatmap, calendar, treemap...) or the single value (gauge, progress, stat). |
| `size` | `string` | Bubble size column. |
| `label` | `string` | Label column, or the caption for gauge / progress / stat. |
| `open` | `string` | Open column (candlestick, ohlc). |
| `high` | `string` | High column. |
| `low` | `string` | Low column. |
| `close` | `string` | Close column. |
| `from` | `string` | Lower bound column (range). |
| `to` | `string` | Upper bound column (range). |
| `min` | `number` | Minimum (gauge, progress). |
| `max` | `number` | Maximum (gauge, progress, radialBar). |
| `stack` | `boolean \| 'percent'` | Stack series: true, or 'percent' for 100% stacks. |
| `horizontal` | `boolean` | Bars, boxes and progress go sideways. |
| `curve` | `'smooth' \| 'linear' \| 'step'` | Line shape. |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fill under a line. |
| `window` | `number` | Live mode: keep the last N rows and scroll at constant speed. |
| `bins` | `number` | Histogram bin count (default: automatic). |
| `inner` | `number` | Donut hole as a fraction of the radius. |
| `units` | `number` | Waffle unit count (default 100). |
| `sort` | `'asc' \| 'desc'` | Sort categories by value. |
| `labels` | `boolean` | Show value labels on bars, slices and cells. |
| `cell` | `number \| 'fine' \| 'normal' \| 'chunky'` | Tile size: 'fine' (3px), 'normal' (6px), 'chunky' (12px) or pixels. |
| `gap` | `number` | Gap between tiles as a fraction of the cell (default 3/16). |
| `round` | `number` | Tile corner radius as a fraction of the cell (default 3/16). |
| `theme` | `'dark' \| 'light' \| 'auto' \| Partial<ThemeTokens>` | 'dark', 'light', 'auto' or a partial token object. |
| `colors` | `string[] \| Record<string, string>` | Series colours: a list, or { seriesName: colour }. |
| `series` | `Record<string, SeriesOptions>` | Per-series overrides keyed by series name. |
| `format` | `FormatName \| ((v: number) => string)` | Value format: 'compact', 'number', 'percent', 'currency', 'bytes', 'duration' or a function. |
| `title` | `string` | Title above the chart. |
| `subtitle` | `string` | Subtitle under the title. |
| `legend` | `boolean \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'right'` | Legend: true, false, 'top', 'bottom' or 'right'. Default: shown when there are 2+ series. |
| `tooltip` | `boolean \| ((p: ChartPoint) => string)` | false, or a function (point) => string. |
| `axes` | `boolean` | false hides axes and gridlines (sparklines). |
| `xAxis` | `AxisOptions` | x axis: { min, max, label, format, ticks }. |
| `yAxis` | `AxisOptions` | y axis: { min, max, label, format, log, ticks }. |
| `annotations` | `Annotation[]` | Reference lines and bands: { y, label } | { x, label } | { from, to, label, axis }. |
| `layers` | `Partial<ChartOptions>[]` | Combo charts: extra option objects drawn on the same axes, inheriting from the parent. |
| `zoom` | `boolean \| 'x' \| 'xy'` | Wheel / pinch / drag zoom and pan: true, 'x' or 'xy'. |
| `brush` | `boolean \| 'x'` | Drag to select a range: true or 'x'. Emits 'select'. |
| `group` | `string` | Charts with the same group share crosshair, hover and zoom. |
| `animate` | `boolean \| { speed?: number }` | false, or { speed } (default speed 1). |

## Per-series options (`series: { name: {...} }`)

| Option | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `string` |  |
| `type` | `string` | Draw this series as another type (creates a layer). |
| `axis` | `'left' \| 'right'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `format` | `FormatName \| ((v: number) => string)` |  |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  |
| `pattern` | `'solid' \| 'checker' \| 'stripe' \| 'dots'` | Tile texture for print and colour-vision deficiency. |

## Chart types

`line`, `area`, `bar`, `histogram`, `scatter`, `bubble`, `range`, `candlestick`, `ohlc`, `boxplot`, `waterfall`, `heatmap`, `calendar`, `pie`, `donut`, `gauge`, `radialBar`, `radar`, `rose`, `waffle`, `treemap`, `funnel`, `progress`, `stat`
